description:
Sit back and relax around the campfire with our Lightweight Folding Camp Stool. At 16.5 inches, this outdoor chair is the perfect height from the ground, offering a comfortable place to sit when out adventuring. These foldable stools are great for camping, fishing, hunting, travel, BBQs, and other outdoor activities.

 

Portable Design:

  • The camping stool measures 16.5 inch x 15.25 inch x 12.5 inch when fully opened. The expanded 10.5 inch x 12 inch seat provides plenty of space for a comfortable sitting position. In addition, the fishing stool folds in half for easy carrying on your backpack, and measures 20.5 inch x 15.25 inch x 2.25 inch when folded. These folding camping stools only weigh 3 LBS.

 

Durable and Long-Lasting:

  • This rugged camping chair is built with a premium 600D polyester construction and strong steel legs for years of use in the great outdoors. From fishing along the shoreline to a week-long camping trip, you will want to keep this comfortable chair alongside you. 

 

Weight Capacity:

  • These hunting stools support up to 220 LBS., offering a high weight limit for a relaxed seating position, no matter the time or place.

 

Gear Up for Adventure:

  • Stock up on camping and survival supplies! From our field-proven Jungle Hammock to our wide variety of backpacks and rucksacks, Rothco has you covered!
